1.title: Connect an Attendance Device
1.description: Connect a fingerprint, face or RFID attendance device that supports eEdu's signed push so every punch arrives automatically.
1.content:
Before you start: an owner/teacher login, a powered device on the network, and the device clock set to Asia/Dhaka .

 

 1. Register the device in eEdu

1. Go to → Settings tab → Devices .
2. Click Add Device and fill in:

 Field What to enter 
 
 Model e.g. 
 Device type Fingerprint / Face / RFID card 
 Location e.g. 
 Target group Students, Teachers, or both 

3. Click Save and copy the Device Secret Key now — it is shown only once.

 [!WARNING]
 The Device Secret Key is the device's password. Keep it in a password manager; rotate it from the same screen if it ever leaks.

 

 2. Point the device at eEdu

Open the device's settings (browser page or LCD menu) and set:

 Device setting Value 
 
 Communication mode TCP/IP 
 Attendance mode Push (Cloud) 
 Server address · Port 
 Push URL 
 Device Secret Key the key from step 1 
 Clock Asia/Dhaka (UTC +6) , NTP on 
 Offline buffer On 

 Does your device support eEdu?

eEdu only accepts punches that are signed by the device itself — a security check the device firmware performs, not something your staff has to configure.

 A device that cannot sign its own requests is not supported . Confirm this with your supplier before you buy .
 Device vendors and integrators can request the full technical specification from eEdu.

 ZKTeco / ADMS (iClock) devices: the vendor's native push format is not supported directly, because it cannot sign requests. Such devices need a gateway — contact eEdu support before installation.

 

 3. Test the connection

1. Punch a known user on the device.
2. Open (Devices section) → Punch Logs .
3. You should see the punch as Processed with the right name. The device turns Active and its Serial is captured automatically.

 [!NOTE]
 The video below covers the device side setup (network, time, user enrolment). For ZKTeco models that only speak the native ADMS/iClock push, arrange the gateway with eEdu support first — otherwise the punch never reaches us.

 

 

 4. Set the clock (very important)

Wrong times are the 1 cause of “wrong day” attendance.

1. Device settings → Clock / Date Time .
2. Timezone Asia/Dhaka (GMT+6) and turn on NTP / time sync .
3. Punch again to confirm.

 

 Done

Students are marked Present or Late by your class timing rules; teacher check ins feed overtime for payroll. If the internet drops, the device buffers and re sends.

Next: Map Device User IDs to Students & Teachers .
 [!TIP]
 Two habits prevent most support calls: keep the clock NTP synced, and keep the Device Secret Key in a password manager.

2.title: Fixing Offline & Sync Problems
2.description: Diagnose a device that is offline, not sending punches, or showing the wrong time.
2.content:
If punches don't appear in eEdu, work down this list.

 

 1. Is the device online?

On the device, open COMM / Network and check it has an IP address.

 No IP → check the LAN cable / Wi Fi password, then reboot.
 Has IP but no internet → on another device at school, open any website. If that fails, fix the school internet first.

 

 

 2. Is it pointing at eEdu?

 Setting Must be 
 
 Attendance mode Push / Cloud 
 Server / Push URL 
 Port 
 Secret key matches eEdu 
 Request signing Device sends (ms) and a valid (see the device guide) 

 [!NOTE]
 Re check the push URL and secret key in (Devices section). A single wrong character stops all punches.

 

 

 3. Is the time right?

Wrong time = wrong day/late status.

1. Device → Clock → timezone Asia/Dhaka (GMT+6) .
2. Turn on NTP / time sync , save and reboot.

 

 4. Is the eEdu side healthy?

1. Open (Devices section).
2. Check status (Active?) and the Pending buffer count.
3. Open Punch Logs :
 New/queued → eEdu is catching up; wait a moment.
 Error → usually a key or mapping issue.

 

 Still stuck?

 Symptom Likely cause 
 
 Nothing at all Wrong push URL/key, or device offline 
 Some punches missing Network drop; device buffers and re sends when back 
 Wrong person User ID mismatch — see User ID mapping 
 Wrong day/time Device clock/timezone 

If it still fails, contact eEdu support with the device model, serial and status .

Next: Connect Your Own Domain .

3.title: Map Device User IDs to Students & Teachers
3.description: Make each fingerprint or card match the right person by enrolling the exact eEdu ID on the device.
3.content:
A device only sends a user ID (the number stored on the machine). eEdu matches that number to a student or teacher. Keep the two identical and attendance is automatic.

 

 

 The rule

Enroll the exact same number on the device as the eEdu ID:

 On the device In eEdu 
 
 Enrolled user ID, e.g. Admission no. (student) or Employee ID (teacher) 

 IDs are numbers only and are zero padded to at least 6 digits (for example , ).
 Enter the ID with its leading zeros . Do not add prefixes such as or .
 Some devices drop leading zeros when a number is stored as an integer. Check that the device shows , not . If it does not, the device cannot be used for this ID.

 

 Setting the device user ID

1. In eEdu, open Students (or Teachers ) and note the Admission no. (or Employee ID ).
2. On the device, enroll the person with that exact number as the user ID.
3. Punch once and confirm the correct name in the punch log (see below).

For many enrolments, use the device's bulk user import if it has one, rather than enrolling each person by hand.

 

 Check it worked

Open Dashboard → Students → Attendance → Settings → Devices → Punch Logs for the device. Each punch shows the device user ID, the matched person, time, direction and status.

 Status Meaning Action 
 
 Processed Matched and recorded. None. 
 Error: Student / Teacher not recognized on this device No eEdu person has this ID. Check the ID on the device against eEdu. 
 Error: Student not enrolled in any active class The person exists but is not in an active class. Add the student to a class. 

 [!TIP]
 If a punch shows "not recognized", the most common cause is a missing or dropped leading zero. Compare the device ID with the eEdu ID character by character.

 

Next: Fixing Offline & Sync Problems .

4.content:
Pick a guide below. Each one is short, visual and safe to try — every action can be undone.

 Build your school website and connect your own domain. 
 Attendance, fees, exams, homework, notices and payroll.

 Fix common problems fast. 
 

 Popular tasks

 Collect fees and print a QR receipt → Fee Collection
 Set up an attendance device → Device Setup

 How to read these guides

5.title: Add & Manage Students
5.description: Add a student, link guardians, enrol them into a classroom, download ID cards, and import or export the register.
5.content:
The student register is the source of truth for attendance, fees, exams and both portals. Add each student once, correctly — everything else reads from this record.

 

 1. Add a student

 → Add student . The form is split into six groups; only the star marked fields are required.

 Section What to enter 
 
 Basic information Full name, gender, blood group, date of birth; NID and photo if you have them 
 Guardian / Parent information At least one guardian — see step 2 
 Address & additional details Division / District / Upazila, address, previous school, transfer certificate number 
 Emergency contact Name, phone, relation 
 Additional notes Free text, up to 500 characters 
 Documents Up to 20 links (birth certificate, photos, forms) 

 Save changes creates the record.

 [!TIP]
 Entering a phone number for the student or guardian automatically creates a login account for that person's portal. Leave it blank only if you do not want them to log in yet.

 

 2. Link guardians

A student needs at least one guardian . On the form, use Add guardian for extra guardians (both parents, or a guardian and a grandparent).

 Fill Name , Phone and Relation .
 Tick Primary guardian on the one person the school deals with — only one can be primary.
 Guardian phone is what creates the parent login, so use the number the family actually answers.

Guardians can be edited later from the student's profile → Guardians tab ( Add guardian / Edit / Remove ).

 

 3. Find and maintain the register

 :

 Search by name or admission number.
 Filter by status (Active, Inactive, Suspended, Graduated, Dropout, Archived), gender or classroom.
 Select rows for bulk Edit / Delete / Archive / Restore .
 Each row's menu gives View profile , Edit student , Send SMS , Archive .

 Archive hides a student without destroying history — prefer it over Delete. Delete is only offered where it is safe.

 

 4. Enrol into a classroom & transfer

 :

1. Enroll student → pick student, classroom and academic year → save. The student now appears in that class's attendance, fees and results.
2. To move a student between classrooms mid year, select the row → Transfer student and choose the new class. Past records stay with the original class.
3. Import spreadsheet / Export CSV handle the whole batch.

 [!NOTE]
 Attendance, exam marks and fees are all attached to the enrollment , not just the student. A student with no enrollment shows up nowhere in the daily register.

 

 5. ID card, transfer certificate & health records

Open any student ( → View profile ). The header gives:

 Download ID card — printable PDF.
 Transfer certificate — issue a TC when a student leaves.
 Collect payment — jump straight to fee collection.
 Archive / Restore / Delete .

Tabs: Personal , Academic , Fees , Attendance , Guardians , Health .

The Health tab stores checkups, vaccinations, medication, allergies and injuries with a severity level — useful for staff on trips or during an emergency.

 

 6. Import and export in bulk

Most list screens in eEdu share the same flow, so learning it once covers students, teachers, enrollments, classrooms, subjects, homework, holidays and library books:

1. Click Import CSV / Import spreadsheet .
2. Download template , fill it in, then Upload a spreadsheet (Excel or CSV).
3. Column mapping — match your columns to eEdu fields (or Ignore this column ).
4. Check the counts — rows detected , valid , need attention — preview, then confirm.
5. If anything fails, Download error report lists the row and the reason.

 Export CSV (or Export → Excel ) exists on the same toolbars for backups and offline analysis.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Save refused Fill the starred fields, especially a guardian 
 Student missing from a class They have no enrollment — do step 4 
 Guardian can't log in The guardian phone must be unique — check it 
 Wrong class on old records That is expected — transfers keep history in place 
 Import fails at confirm Fix the rows in the error report and re upload 

Next: Class Routine & Timetable .

6.title: Add Teachers & Set Permissions
6.description: Add staff records, give them a login, and control what each person can see and do.
6.content:
1. Add a teacher's record

 → Add Teacher :

 Field What to enter 
 
 Full name as it should appear on registers and payslips 
 Designation / Department e.g. Assistant Teacher · Science 
 Phone / Email email needed for dashboard access 
 Employee ID leave blank — eEdu generates it 
 Joining date first working day 
 Show on website list them on your public “Our Teachers” page 
 Grant dashboard access give them a login (step 2) 

Save. The Employee ID (e.g. ) is also the number biometric devices use — see User ID mapping.

 

 2. Give them a login

eEdu picks the right path automatically:

 Existing eEdu account → access is granted instantly.
 New user → eEdu emails an invite link to create a password.

To grant: open the teacher → Invite / Dashboard access → choose a role → save. If the link expires, just send a new one.

 

 3. Set what they can do

 (owner only). Each feature is set to:

 Level Meaning 
 
 Write view and change 
 Read view only 
 Off hidden from their menu 

Tick features ( Attendance, Fees, Results, Students, Reports …), optionally limit a teacher to specific classrooms , and save.

 [!TIP]
 Start new teachers on Read . Most need only: Attendance, Results, Homework and their own Leave.

 

 4. My Space (what teachers see)

Each teacher gets a personal My Space : profile, attendance and calendar, leave with status, payslips, and their timetable/classes. Members can never see another teacher's salary.

 

 5. Remove access

Open the teacher → Archive (keeps records, drops login). History stays in reports. Re archiving restores the HR record only — re grant access separately if they return.

Next: Add & Manage Students .

7.title: Plans, Billing & Payments
7.description: Check your plan, upgrade or renew with a coupon, top up the wallet, and track invoices and transactions.
7.content:
Everything about money your institute pays eEdu lives under : Wallet, Transactions, Invoices, My plan, Referrals and Payment Gateway.

 [!NOTE]
 Wallet, Transactions and My plan are owner only. Regular staff members will not see them — ask the workspace owner if a change is needed.

 

 1. See what your plan includes

 lists the Free and paid tiers with what each one unlocks. The sidebar footer shows a live usage meter (students and classrooms used vs. your limit) and a Renew button.

Three features are paid tier only: SMS credits , WhatsApp and a custom domain . Everything else — students, attendance, exams, fees, timetable, library, reports — works on Free.

 

 2. Upgrade or renew

1. → choose the plan.
2. Have a discount? Click Have a coupon code? , type the code, Apply — the discount appears next to it. View available offers lists the live promotions.
3. Pay with Pay Online (bKash, Nagad, card…) or Wallet Balance .
4. Confirm — access unlocks immediately.

Members who are not the owner see Contact your workspace admin to upgrade the plan instead of the payment options.

 [!TIP]
 The sidebar Renew button is the fastest path when a plan has simply expired.

 

 3. Top up the wallet

 → Top up .

 Amounts between ৳500 and ৳50,000 per top up.
 Balance pays for plan renewals and other eEdu charges without re entering card details.
 Every top up appears in Transactions with its source.

 

 4. Invoices & transactions

 Page Shows 
 
 Invoices Invoice number, type (Subscription, Wallet Top up, Salary, Refund), amount, status (Issued / Paid / Refunded / Void) and a Download PDF per row 
 Transactions Every movement of money with status, source and type filters 

Use an invoice PDF as your accounting record; use Transactions to reconcile what actually cleared.

 

 5. Referrals

 holds your referral code and the rewards earned when another institute signs up with it. Share the code — credits land in your wallet when they qualify.

 

 6. Payment gateway (parent online fees)

Setup for parents paying fees online lives in : connect a provider (bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz, ShurjoPay, ePS, aamarPay, DGePay) and enter your own merchant credentials.

Full steps are in Student Fees & QR Receipts §5.

 

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Section says “unavailable” Your plan does not include it — open My plan and upgrade 
 “Access paused” banner The workspace is past due — Renew 
 Staff member can't open Wallet/My plan Owner only — ask the owner 
 Coupon won't apply Expired, wrong plan, or already used 
 Gateway won't save Check Client ID / Secret / API key with your provider 

Next: Exams, Marks & Results .

8.title: Class Routine & Timetable
8.description: Create classrooms and subjects, then build the weekly routine that powers period-wise attendance.
8.content:
The routine drives period wise attendance , teacher schedules and the public routine page.

 

 1. Check classrooms

 → add any missing class (e.g. ) with its shift and the current academic year .

 

 2. Add subjects

 → Add Subject . For each subject set its papers:

 Paper Set 
 
 CQ Total and pass marks (e.g. 50 / 15) 
 MCQ Total and pass marks 
 Practical if applicable 
 Viva if applicable 

 [!TIP]
 Match these to your board handbook — they drive grading and the printed marksheet.

 

 3. Assign subjects to a class

Open the classroom and add the subjects that class studies. For streams (Science/Business/Humanities), set the stream group so the right subjects attach.

 

 4. Build the weekly grid

 → New Timetable → choose classroom + term. Fill each day and period :

 Field Value 
 
 Period / time e.g. 08:30–09:20 
 Subject from the class list 
 Teacher who takes it 
 Room optional 

eEdu warns about conflicts (same teacher or class in two periods). Save.

 

 5. Verify & publish

 Check a teacher's My Space shows only their periods.
 Confirm every period is covered.
 Published copies appear on the public site's Routine page (if enabled).

 

 6. Academic events calendar

The same screen has a third tab — → Academic Events — for everything that is not a lesson: exams, holidays, result days, meetings and deadlines.

 Add event → Title, Date, optional End date (or tick All day ), Category (Exam, Holiday, Event, Deadline, Meeting, Other) → Save .

 Setting Effect 
 
 Target audience Everyone, specific classrooms, or teachers only 
 Classrooms limit it to the classes it concerns 
 Show on public website publish it on the institute's site 

Students and parents see the same calendar under their Timetable → Academic Events tab, so nothing needs to be sent separately.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Teacher missing Add them first — Teachers guide 
 Subject missing Assign it to the classroom (step 3) 
 Conflict warning Move one of the two clashing periods 
 Event not visible Tick Show on public website and pick the right audience 

Next: Student Fees & QR Receipts .

9.title: Notices, SMS & WhatsApp
9.description: Broadcast announcements, send SMS and WhatsApp messages, and use in-app chat.
9.content:
Use in app notices for logged in users, and SMS/WhatsApp to reach guardians who may not open the app.

 

 1. Send a notice

 → Add Announcement (create notices under , or use Notify classroom on a timetable entry):

 Field Value 
 
 Title / Message your text 
 Audience whole institute or a classroom 
 Channel in app, SMS, WhatsApp 
 Schedule now or later 

It appears under Notices / Announcements in the student and parent portals. is only the inbox for reading and clearing them.

 

 2. SMS

 :

1. Buy/recharge credits and register a Sender ID (approved by eEdu).
2. Compose a message, choose recipients (class or all), send.
3. Track delivery status , orders and logs.

 [!WARNING]
 Attendance and absence alerts also draw from the same credit — recharge before exam season.

 

 3. WhatsApp

 :

1. Connect your school's WhatsApp by scanning the QR.
2. Set up auto reply , templates , contacts/groups and delivery reports .
3. Send notices from the Announcements form or in bulk here.

 [!NOTE]
 WhatsApp runs from your own number. Keep the phone connected; a long disconnect needs a re scan.

 

 4. In app chat

 is real time chat with staff and portal users.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Sender ID not working Approval may be pending 
 SMS not delivered Low credit or invalid number 
 WhatsApp disconnected Re scan the QR 
 Guardian didn't get it Tick the SMS/WhatsApp channel when sending 

Next: Transport & Hostel .

10.title: Daily Attendance
10.description: Mark daily or period-wise attendance, review calendars, export registers, and alert guardians about absences.
10.content:
Device punch setup lives in Device & Biometric Setup. This page covers the daily register.

 

 1. Set the rules once

 → Settings :

 Setting Controls 
 
 Marking mode one daily record, or period wise 
 Late cut off time after which a student is Late 
 Weekly holidays days with no attendance 
 Shifts Morning / Day / Evening timings 

Assign each classroom the right shift if you use them.

 

 2. Mark attendance

1. → Mark Attendance .
2. Pick classroom, date and (if period wise) the period.
3. Tap Mark all present , then change only the exceptions: Present / Late / Absent / Leave .
4. Save.

 [!TIP]
 With devices installed, punches fill the register for you — you only correct exceptions (forgot to punch, approved leave).

 

 3. Review & export

From the same screen:

 Monthly calendar per student (colour coded).
 Class summary and low attendance report .
 Export the register to CSV / PDF .

 

 4. Absence alerts

 → Send Alert → pick the student , choose the channel (SMS / WhatsApp / in app), type the message and send. Every alert is logged below with its delivery status, so you can see who was told and when.

 [!WARNING]
 Alerts use your institute's SMS/WhatsApp credit — check the sender ID and balance first.

 

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Can't save Weekly holiday, or no Write permission 
 Everyone is Late Cut off too early, or device clock wrong 
 Punch missing See Offline & sync 

Next: Homework & Assignments .

11.title: Exams, Marks & Results
11.description: Create exam terms and schedules, enter marks, and publish tabulation sheets, merit lists, seat plans and report cards.
11.content:
1. Create the exam term

 (or Exam Results ) → New Term → name it (e.g. ) and set the dates. Add each exam's schedule under the class.

 

 2. Enter marks

1. .
2. Pick the term and classroom → the student roster appears with each subject's components (CQ / MCQ / Practical / Viva).
3. Enter marks (or import from a spreadsheet), leaving a component blank marks it “missing”.

 [!TIP]
 Pass marks and totals come from the subject setup — fix those in Subjects before marks entry.

 

 3. Check the results

The Exam Suite gives you three views:

 View Shows 
 
 Tabulation all marks in one sheet 
 Merit list ranked students 
 Seat plan room by room seating 

Each can be downloaded as PDF .

 Seat plan

The seat plan is generated automatically from the exam routine:

1. Create the exam routine/schedule ( ) with date, room number, invigilator and subject.
2. → pick the exam term and classroom → open the Seat Plan tab.
3. Seats are filled in roll order (default 10 per row). Download the PDF for printing.

 [!TIP]
 Set the room and invigilator on the exam schedule first — the seat plan header uses them.

 

 4. Publish

Only the owner publishes results. Once published, students and parents see them in their portal under Academics → Results , and (if enabled) on the public Exam Results page.

Published documents:

 Marksheet / report card (downloadable PDF)
 Tabulation sheet , merit list and seat plan for printing

 

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Component marked “missing” Fill the blank, or it is intentionally absent 
 Result not visible to family Publish it (owner only) 
 Wrong total Correct the subject's component totals 

Next: Daily Attendance .

12.title: Student Fees & QR Receipts
12.description: Set up fees, collect at the counter or online, and print receipts parents can verify by QR.
12.content:
1. Set up the fee

 One off: → Add Fee → student, category, amount, discount, month/year, due date → Save.

 Monthly (recommended): → New Template → add items (Tuition ৳1500, …), set billing day and due day offset , pick the classroom (or all classrooms). eEdu then creates each month's bills automatically.

 Why use fee templates?

 Consistency — every enrolled student in the classroom gets the same fee heads each month; no manual re entry.
 Automation — on the billing day the system generates invoices (skipping any already created for that month).
 Control — activate/deactivate a template, change items, or run Generate Now for the current month.
 Traceability — generated fees link back to the template.

 One off fees & corrections

 → New Fee → pick classroom, month and year, then add fee heads with base amount, discount and fine. The form prefills from the student's existing statement, so saving updates it instead of duplicating. Use this for one off charges (admission, library fine) or to correct a bill a template produced.

 Installment plans

For a large bill, → New Plan → student, total amount, number of installments (2–60), start month/year, due day. The system splits the total into scheduled monthly installments; the last installment absorbs rounding. Progress (paid/total) is tracked and unpaid installments are removed on cancellation.

 Why use installment plans? 

 Lets families spread a big fee (admission, development) over months.
 Keeps the ledger accurate — each installment is a real fee with its own due date and status.
 Shows progress so staff and parents see what is settled.

Built in fee heads include Tuition, Admission, Exam, Transport, Hostel, Library, Development and more.

 

 2. Collect at the counter

1. → Collect Payment (or open the statement).
2. Search the student, tick the bills being paid .
3. Enter amount received and method (Cash, Bank, Mobile Banking, Cheque, Card/Online, Wallet, Free).
4. Click Pay .

The bill turns Paid/Partial , totals are locked against double collection, and an audit record is saved. Overpayments are refused — collect the exact remaining amount.

 

 3. Print the QR receipt

From the confirmation, click Print / Download receipt . The PDF shows institute details, receipt number, each fee line, the total, and a QR code .

 

 

 4. Parents verify a receipt

Scan the QR with any phone camera → opens the eEdu verification page showing receipt number, amount, date, institute and student. A tampered or fake receipt shows “signature invalid” .

 

 5. Let parents pay online

1. Go to , add a provider (bKash / Nagad / SSLCommerz / DGePay …), and enter your merchant credentials.
2. Enable online payment for the student/parent portal.

Parents then see Pay Online on the fee statement. Money goes to your own account ; eEdu marks the fee paid and creates the same QR receipt once the gateway confirms.

 

 

 Discounts & scholarships

Open the fee → set Waived amount for a scholarship (record a free ৳0 payment for a clean audit trail). To spread a large bill across months, use Installment plans above.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Bill not showing Check month/year and active classroom 
 “Exceeds remaining due” Collect less, or waive/discount first 
 Online payment stuck eEdu settles on return — see payment issues 
 Receipt shows invalid Issue a new receipt and void the old one 

Next: Plans, Billing & Payments .

13.title: Homework & Assignments
13.description: Assign homework to a class, track who submitted, and grade submissions — visible to students and parents.
13.content:
1. Create homework

 → Add Homework :

 Field Value 
 
 Title e.g. 
 Classroom the class that must do it 
 Subject which subject 
 Description the instruction students see 
 Due date the deadline 
 Attachment optional worksheet / PDF 

Save/publish — it appears instantly in the student and parent portals.

 

 2. Track submissions

Open a homework to see each student as Submitted or Pending (with time). Click a student to view or download their upload.

 

 3. Review & grade

Open a submission → add a mark and optional feedback → save.

 

 4. What families see

 Student: — description, due date, attachments, and upload their answer.
 Parent: the same list per child, to follow up at home.

Full walkthrough for families: Student & Parent Portal.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Not visible Save/publish, and check the active classroom 
 Can't upload Portal access missing, or the due date passed 
 Wrong subject Add the subject to the class first 

Next: Notices, SMS & WhatsApp .

14.title: Library & Book Issues
14.description: Manage the book catalog, issue and return books, track fines, and handle reservations.
14.content:
1. Add books to the catalog

 → Add Book → title, author, ISBN, category, copies, fine/day, borrow days → Save. Use Import spreadsheet for bulk entry.

Each book tracks available vs. total copies automatically.

 

 2. Issue a book

1. .
2. Open a book's actions → Issue (only enabled when a copy is in stock).
3. Select the student and set the due date (defaults to borrow days from today).
4. Save — the copy is marked issued and the student's statement shows the borrow.

 

 3. Return or mark lost

 :

 Return — marks the issue returned, calculates any late fine, frees the copy.
 Lost — marks the issue lost and charges a lost book fine.

 

 4. Reservations

When a book is out of stock, open its actions → Reserve and pick a student. The student joins the queue in order.

 On return of a copy, the earliest pending reservation becomes Ready (3 day pickup window).
 Cancel removes the reservation; the book stays in the catalog.

 shows the queue and status.

 

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Cannot issue No available copy — reserve instead 
 Fine wrong Adjust borrow days / fine per day on the book 
 Reservation stuck Cancel and re create 

Next: Student & Parent Portal .

15.title: My Space, Leave & Performance
15.description: What teachers do themselves in My Space, how leave requests are raised and approved, and how staff performance reviews work.
15.content:
Teachers do not need admin access for their own records. My Space is their self service area, and leave plus performance reviews run through it.

 

 1. My Space (teacher self service)

 — one page, eleven tabs:

 Tab What a teacher finds 
 
 Overview Today's duties and a summary of everything below 
 Attendance Their own attendance record 
 Leave Balance, history and Apply for Leave 
 Salary Monthly payslips with Download Payslip 
 Loans Advances taken and repayment status 
 Timetable Their weekly periods 
 Classes / Students / Homework / Exam Duties What they teach and what they have set 
 Performance Their approved review, read only 

 [!NOTE]
 Use the tabs on this page . A teacher with no linked teacher profile sees No teacher profile — an admin must link the account first in Add Teachers & Permissions.

 

 2. Request leave (teacher)

In → Apply for Leave :

1. Type — Casual, Sick, Earned, Unpaid or Special.
2. From and To — the day count updates as you change them.
3. Reason — required.
4. Submit . Pending requests can be withdrawn with Cancel .

The request moves to the approval queue below.

 

 3. Approve or reject leave (admin/owner)

 → tabs All / Pending / Approved / Rejected :

 Open a request, read the reason and dates, then Approve or Reject (a note can be attached).
 Each row shows the period, reason and whether it is Paid or Unpaid .
 Import allows bulk submitting leave from a spreadsheet for a batch of teachers.

Approved leave updates the teacher's balance automatically.

 

 4. Set leave quotas

 → Set quotas → teacher, leave type, Entitled days → save.

The table shows Entitled / Used / Remaining per teacher per type (Casual, Sick, Earned, Unpaid, Special), so balances are visible before anyone applies. Set them at the start of the year.

 

 5. Performance reviews

 → Add appraisal :

 Field Notes 
 
 Teacher, Year, Period who and when 
 Rating Excellent / Good / Average / Poor — this suggests a score (90 / 75 / 55 / 30); override it 0–100 if needed 
 Strengths, Areas to improve, Goals, Comments the written review 

Status runs Draft → Submit → Approve . Only an approved review is visible to the teacher, read only under My Space → Performance .

Appraisals are created and approved by the institute owner or an admin with Performance permission.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix

3. Adjust any line (bonus, fine, advance recovery).
4. Click Pay (single or Bulk Pay ).

17.title: Reports & Analytics
17.description: Track collection rate, outstanding dues and attendance across the institute, and export the numbers you need.
17.content:
answers three questions: how much did we collect , who still owes us , and how is attendance running .

 

 1. The headline numbers

Across the top of the page:

 Metric Meaning 
 
 Total students active students in the current view 
 Total collection money received, with the change vs the previous period 
 Total due outstanding fee items and how many students they belong to 
 Collection rate collected ÷ total payable 
 Attendance average attendance over the selected date range 

Use the date range control to compare a month, a term or a year.

 

 2. Financial tab

 3. Due list

The due table sits with the financial report and shows unpaid / partially paid fees , filtered by classroom and month.

This is the list to work from for fee reminders — each row is a real outstanding amount, and it has its own Export CSV .

 5. Student analytics (student portal)

Students and parents get their own view at :

 KPIs: Attendance , Best GPA , Due , Health records 
 Attendance trend , Exam performance , Fee overview , Subject performance 

It is read only and reflects published data only.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix

 Need it in Excel Export CSV on the Financial tab and the Due list

18.title: Transport & Hostel
18.description: Set up bus routes, vehicles and drivers, hostel rooms, and subscribe students to either with its monthly fee.
18.content:
Both facilities work the same way: define the facility once, then give each student a subscription that carries the monthly fee.

 

 1. Add a transport route

 → Add route :

 Field Example 
 
 Route name Mirpur–School 
 Start location Mirpur 10 
 End location School gate 
 Monthly fee ৳1,500

The monthly fee on the route automatically fills every new subscription — staff never retype it.

 

 2. Vehicles and drivers

Still under :

 Vehicles → Add vehicle → registration no., model, capacity.
 Drivers → Add driver → name, phone, licence no.

A driver can then be attached to a route or vehicle, so the register shows who runs what.

 

 3. Subscribe a student to a route

 → Add subscription → student, route, monthly fee (already filled from the route) → save.

The subscription is what bills the family. Add it as a Transport fee head so it shows on the statement like any other charge.

To end it, open the subscription and remove it — future bills stop, past ones stay.

 

 4. Add a hostel and rooms

1. Add hostel → name, type, address, monthly fee → save.
2. With the hostel in place, click Add room (top right, or on the hostel itself) → room no., floor, capacity / bed count.

Each room shows how many beds are left, so you can see availability before subscribing anyone.

 

 5. Subscribe a student to a hostel

 → Add subscription → student, hostel, room, monthly fee → save. Bill it as a Hostel fee head.

Transport and hostel fees can both be generated monthly from a fee template instead of by hand.

 

 Bulk entry

Every tab in Transport and Hostel has Import spreadsheet and Export CSV using the standard flow — download the template, map your columns, review the counts, confirm.

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix 
 
 Fee typed twice on subscriptions Set it on the route / hostel first — subscriptions inherit it 
 Room shows no beds left Raise capacity, or free a seat by removing a subscription 
 Student not billed A subscription alone does not bill — add the fee head or a template 
 Menu missing Transport & Hostel are gated by plan — see Plans & Billing 

Next: Payroll, Salary & Loans .

19.title: Student & Parent Portal

19.content:
Every student and guardian gets their own login. They sign in at the school address (e.g. ) with the email/phone and password the school provided.

 

 Student portal

A guardian follows one or more children from a single login. Use the child switcher at the top to change the selected child.

 Menu Shows

 Academics attendance, timetable, homework, results

 Paying fees online

1. Finance → Fees → open the unpaid month.
2. Pay Online → choose a method (bKash / Nagad / card / bank).
3. Complete payment on the gateway page.
4. The fee turns Paid and a QR receipt is created automatically.

 If a payment is interrupted, don't pay twice — check Payment History after a few minutes. See payment issues.

20.title: Attendance: Logs Won't Sync or Look Wrong
20.description: Fix punches that never arrive, arrive late, or land on the wrong day or person.
20.content:
"Punched but shows absent" — follow the sections in order.

 

 1. Did the punch reach eEdu?

 (Devices section) → open the device's Punch Logs (filter today).

 You see Meaning Next 
 
 Punch listed eEdu received it §2 
 Punch but Error No person matched §4 
 Nothing Never arrived §5 

 

 2. Punch arrived but the register looks wrong

 Check the view — right classroom , shift and date ? The register only counts the class's day.
 "Late", not "Present" — a punch after the late cut off ( ) is still attendance.
 Today isn't final — the automatic absent check never marks today early.

 

 3. Half empty day

1. Students must be enrolled in the class for the active year.
2. The device's target group must include students.
3. In period wise mode, only students with a period that day appear.

 

 4. Punches show "Error"

The device user ID doesn't match anyone: note the ID, compare with the student's admission no. / teacher's employee ID, then fix the mapping or re enroll. Errors never create fake absences. See User ID mapping.

 

 5. Nothing arrived (device side)

Check push mode, server / port 443, the secret key, whether the device supports eEdu's signed push, internet, and the clock (institute time zone, ).

 [!NOTE]
 Requests rejected with a wrong key, a bad signature or a malformed time are not stored , so they never appear in Punch Logs. If the device shows nothing here, check the device's own push/error log.

Full walkthrough: Device offline & sync. After the network returns, wait a few minutes — the device buffers and re sends.

 

 6. Repair a past day

Open that day's register and mark individuals (within the back date limit, usually 7 days). You can't mark a future date. Don't mark today as a repair — a later correct punch upgrades it automatically.

 

 Quick decision table

 Symptom Do first 
 
 Nothing in Punch Logs Device guide (network/mode/key/clock) 
 Punch here, register empty Wrong class/shift/date 
 "Late" not "Present" Late cutoff settings 
 Error status User ID mapping 
 Absent looks wrong Enrollment / academic year / approved leave 

Next: Payments & Receipt Verification .

21.title: Frequently Asked Questions
21.description: Short answers to the questions every school office asks about eEdu.
21.content:
Quick answers. Where a topic has a full guide, the link is bold.

 

 Accounts & access

 One login for several schools? Yes — use the workspace switcher in the dashboard. Permissions are separate per school.

 A teacher can't see a menu? Their permission is Read/Off . The owner widens it in . Only owners approve leave and run salary. See Teachers & Permissions.

 Invitation expired? Open the teacher → Dashboard access → send a new invite.

 Who is the owner? Whoever registered the institute — the only one who manages team, subscription and publishing.

 

 Attendance & devices

 Punches arrive but nothing shows? Check the device's Punch Logs — a Processed row should appear within minutes, else see Logs won't sync.

 Punches show "Error"? The user ID isn't matched — fix mapping.

 Wrong day/time? Set the device to Asia/Dhaka + NTP — see Device setup.

 Absence looks wrong? Check the student is enrolled, the class matches the device, and any approved leave is recorded (leave shows On Leave , not absent).

 

 Fees & payments

 How do parents pay online? Connect a gateway first, then enable online payment — money goes to your own bKash/Nagad account. See Fee Collection.

 Payment stuck on Pending? Click Check / Verify Payment — see payment issues.

 How do I verify a receipt? Scan its QR — the public page shows Verified ; an altered receipt says "may be forged".

 Do fees generate each month? Yes, if you use a fee template .

 Can part of a bill be waived? Yes — set a waived amount /discount; big bills can be split into installments (2–60).

 

 Exams & results

 GPA 0.00 despite passing most subjects? One failed subject (F) fails the whole result (Board rule) — check the tabulation sheet. See Exams & Results.

 Change a mark after publishing? Yes — unpublish → correct → republish .

 Where is the seat plan? → pick class + term → print or export the PDF.

 

 Website & domain

 Domain stuck on Pending? Usually a missing/mistyped TXT record — copy exactly, then Verify . See Connect Your Domain.

 Renew SSL myself? No — it's free and automatic; keep the TXT records. See SSL & Verification.

 Own domain and free subdomain together? Yes, both serve the same site.

 

 Security

 Where does fingerprint data go? Scans stay only on the device ; eEdu stores numbers (admission/employee ID), never a fingerprint or face image.

 Can I share the Device Secret Key? No — treat it like a password. If unsure, rotate it.

 Forgot my password? Use Forgot password on the login screen (email/phone OTP).

 Where do I contact support? → New Request . Tell us your school name, the screen, and what you expected vs what happened.

 

 Still stuck?

 Re read the matching guide from the Home page.
 Open a ticket at → New Request (subject, category, priority, message, up to 2 attachments) and follow it under Open / In Progress / Resolved .
 For payment issues, include the gateway payment reference .

22.title: Payments & Receipt Verification
22.description: Check payment status, settle stuck payments, and verify receipts by QR or number.
22.content:
1. Check a payment's status

 (or Finance → Payments ) → filter by student, date, method, status.

 Status Meaning 
 
 Completed / Paid Money confirmed; fees updated, receipt issued 
 Pending Started, gateway hasn't confirmed yet 
 Failed / Cancelled Rejected — nothing recorded 
 Partially Paid Some covered; balance still due 

 

 2. "Parent paid but it shows Pending"

Usually normal and self resolving:

1. eEdu marks it Completed once the gateway confirms.
2. If the browser closed mid payment, click Check / Verify Payment beside the pending row — eEdu asks the gateway and settles it.
3. Still pending after a few minutes? Some banks are slow — retry in 5–10 minutes.

 [!WARNING]
 Never manually mark a payment "paid" while it shows Pending — when the gateway reply arrives you could collect the fee twice.

 

 3. Verify a payment or receipt

 By reference: search Payment History for the reference/tracking number from the parent's screenshot; confirm Completed , correct student and amount.

 By QR (no login needed): scan the receipt QR with a phone camera → the public page shows receipt number, amount, date, institute and student, with Verified . An altered receipt shows “signature invalid — this receipt may be forged” .

 [!TIP]
 Accept a QR scanned Verified result as proof — it comes from the same server as your ledger. An app screenshot is not proof.

 

 

 4. Reprint a receipt

 (or Receipts ) → search by receipt number, student or date → Print / Download . Numbers look like .

 

 5. Fix mistakes

 Wrong amount: Void the payment, then collect again. Balances return to normal.
 Voiding is recorded in the audit log — never delete, so totals stay explainable.
 Partial then full: partially paid bills stay open until the next payment finishes them.

 

 Quick reference

 I want to… Do this 
 
 See today's collection Payment History, filter by date 
 Settle a stuck payment Check / Verify Payment 
 Prove a receipt is real Scan its QR → public Verified page 
 Reprint a receipt Search → Print 
 Fix a wrong collection Void, then re collect 

Next: Frequently Asked Questions .

Every institute has a public site at . You build it from .

2. Apply it, then set colours and logo under Theme .

3. Preview on desktop and mobile, then Publish .

 Build while unpublished, then flip the site live when it's ready.

 

 3. Turn on live sections

These pull real data instead of static text:

 Section Source 
 
 Notice Board / Announcements content you publish

 5. Put it on your domain

When ready, connect a custom domain: → follow Connect Your Domain.

 

 Troubleshooting

 Problem Fix
